name: datamancy.dev
description: Source for datamancy.dev — the grimoire published as raw markdown + a KMS-signed MCP manifest the datamancy npm adapter verifies against.

scripts.docs:regen: npm run grimoire:regen && npm run vigilia:regen && npm run readme:regen && npm run llms:regen
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/check-shipped-claims.mjs && node scripts/check-warding-ledger.mjs && node scripts/generate-grimoire-skill.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-vigilia-skill.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-readme-catalog.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-llms.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-agent-ready.mjs --check
scripts.manifest:publish: npm run docs:regen && npm run manifest:generate && npm run agent:regen && npm run manifest:sign
